reason: I already screenshot every bank slip and keep a spreadsheet, and it works for me. The slip reading is neat, but I would still have to set up a shortcut and trust an app with my bank text for something I already do by hand.
objection: Setting up an iPhone shortcut and handing my slip text to a new app that only says my data is 'encrypted' is more hassle and more risk than my spreadsheet, which I control completely.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled my credit-card statement in and sorted the categories better than I do now, with almost no setup, and I could export my data out if I left.
